reviewed_by: Claude: settle Setup runner detection in the host automation-image test
reason: Main CI for 409bf4f9 failed test_shared_automation_image_prepare_replay_and_changed_runner[postgresql]. It is a pre-existing race in the test, not a regression from #1322-#1327. The test failed on unmodified 71b3c942 and f229f09a and passed on 2448c2fa, f4c8ee1f and a68c48d2. Main CI had not selected this file in the earlier recorded selections; #1327 selected it with PostgreSQL. Cause: Core start in the settings fixture launches SetupService's background runner detection. When that task lists runner profiles after the test saves its inert 'local' profile, it re-verifies the profile with the real container runtime ('/inert/podman' does not exist) and saves healthy=False, so automation prepare finds no verified runner. The test now awaits that startup detection before it saves the inert profile. A forced interleaving (detection waits for the profile; prepare delayed) fails the old test on SQLite and PostgreSQL and passes the new one. No product code changes. One passing tolerant-entity reader test is selected so the selected CI job provisions PostgreSQL and runs the [postgresql] variants too.
exclusions: Only the edited test file is selected. The selected CI job provisions PostgreSQL only for its listed PostgreSQL trigger suites, so the [postgresql] variants of this file were verified locally against postgres:16-alpine, not in this CI selection. No native, Playwright, frontend or live Core check; no full-suite approval.
